interpretation.samgr_sa_profile_fields: SaProfile and ParseSystemAbilityGetSaExtInfo do not define/read permission or permission_acls; this SAMgr parser accepts JSON SA profile schema and rejects non-JSON profile paths.
interpretation.init_service_cfg_fields: Distinct init service cfg fields are parsed into permission/perms and permission_acls/acls arrays, then passed as inputs to native service AccessToken creation and SetSelfTokenID.
interpretation.acl_limit: AccessToken code uses native ACL entries to include permissions despite an APL available-level threshold. This is token construction policy, not a per-caller service ACL. Runtime product effects depend on AccessToken implementation/policy and build.
interpretation.samgr_query_gate: SAMgr Get/Check/Load SA operations conditionally call SELinux ServiceChecker with IPC caller SID and SA id; WITH_SELINUX absent returns true. This gates acquiring/returning an SA proxy, not each subsequent binder method call to the SA.
interpretation.D52_boundary: D52 profile/3701.xml is XML and its component init cfg path names pasteboard_service.xml. The current SAMgr JSON parser cannot parse that XML. No D52 product manifest/build rule evidence resolves the XML install filename mapping or binds this pinned SAMgr/init/AccessToken revisions to D52 product.
